+"""Tests for fmtcsv: CSV summary output with quoted fields and preserved spacing."""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+from fmtcsv import format_summary, main, parse_csv
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def simple_csv(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "simple.csv"
+    path.write_text("name,age,city\nAlice,30,Paris\nBob,25,London\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def quoted_commas_csv(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "quoted.csv"
+    path.write_text(
+        'name,note\n"Doe, John","likes commas, a lot"\n', encoding="utf-8"
+    )
+    return path
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def padded_quotes_csv(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "padded.csv"
+    path.write_text('name,note\nAlice,"  padded  "\n', encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+def test_parse_csv_simple(simple_csv):
+    rows = parse_csv(simple_csv)
+    assert rows == [
+        ["name", "age", "city"],
+        ["Alice", "30", "Paris"],
+        ["Bob", "25", "London"],
+    ]
+
+
+def test_parse_csv_quoted_commas(quoted_commas_csv):
+    rows = parse_csv(quoted_commas_csv)
+    assert rows[0] == ["name", "note"]
+    # The quoted field containing a comma stays a single field.
+    assert rows[1] == ["Doe, John", "likes commas, a lot"]
+
+
+def test_parse_csv_preserves_spaces_in_quotes(padded_quotes_csv):
+    rows = parse_csv(padded_quotes_csv)
+    assert rows[1] == ["Alice", "  padded  "]
+
+
+def test_format_summary_simple(simple_csv):
+    lines = format_summary(parse_csv(simple_csv))
+    assert lines == [
+        "Total rows: 2",
+        "Total columns: 3",
+        "First data row: ['Alice', '30', 'Paris']",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_format_summary_quoted_commas(quoted_commas_csv):
+    lines = format_summary(parse_csv(quoted_commas_csv))
+    assert lines == [
+        "Total rows: 1",
+        "Total columns: 2",
+        "First data row: ['Doe, John', 'likes commas, a lot']",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_format_summary_preserves_spaces(padded_quotes_csv):
+    lines = format_summary(parse_csv(padded_quotes_csv))
+    assert "First data row: ['Alice', '  padded  ']" in lines
+
+
+def test_format_summary_empty_csv(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "empty.csv"
+    path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
+        format_summary(parse_csv(path))
+
+
+def test_main_missing_file(capsys):
+    assert main(["does-not-exist.csv"]) == 1
+    err = capsys.readouterr().err
+    assert "file not found" in err
+
+
+def test_cli_end_to_end(simple_csv):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "fmtcsv.py", str(simple_csv)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    assert result.stdout == (
+        "Total rows: 2\n"
+        "Total columns: 3\n"
+        "First data row: ['Alice', '30', 'Paris']\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_cli_preserves_quoted_spaces(padded_quotes_csv):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "fmtcsv.py", str(padded_quotes_csv)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    assert "First data row: ['Alice', '  padded  ']" in result.stdout
